y-m-07-06.title: Katunan lamba 3: a ina ne samfurin yake ƙaruwa?
y-m-07-06.topic: Nemo yanayi masu samfurin girma yayin ƙirƙirar furucin (lamba mai lambobi biyu)×(lamba mai lamba ɗaya) da katunan lambobi
y-m-07-06.goal: Gwada ra'ayin ‘idan ka ƙirƙiri lambar lambobi biyu mafi girma, samfurin ma zai fi girma’ ta ƙirƙirar furuci da kanka; nemo furuci da dama masu samfurin girma, ka rubuta dalili.
y-m-07-06.material: Akwai katin lamba guda ɗaya kowanne daga 3, 5, da 7. Yi amfani da kowane kati sau ɗaya daidai wajen ƙirƙirar furucin (lamba mai lambobi biyu)×(lamba mai lamba ɗaya). Misali, jera 3 da 5 su zama 35 sannan ka ninka da 7, wato 35×7 (talatin da biyar sau bakwai). Kada ka juya katunan. Harin ta ce, “Idan na ƙirƙiri lamba mafi girma mai lambobi biyu, 75, na ninka da 3, samfurin zai fi girma!”
y-m-07-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri furuci da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗa
y-m-07-06.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa samfurin yake ƙaruwa
y-m-07-06.prereq.0: Lissafin (lamba mai lambobi biyu)×(lamba mai lamba ɗaya)
y-m-07-06.prereq.1: Yadda ake ƙirƙirar lamba mai lambobi biyu da katunan (matsayin goma-goma, matsayi ɗaya)
y-m-07-06.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hukuncin da za ka iya yanke yanzu game da maganar Harin.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ƙirƙiri wani furuci dabam da 75×3, ka lissafa da kanka, ka kwatanta samfurori.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.hint.1: Da farko ƙirga furuci nawa ne za a iya ƙirƙira gabaɗaya da katunan 3.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne. Idan lambar lambobi biyu ita ce mafi girma, samfurin ma shi ne mafi girma.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.a: Lambar mai lamba ɗaya da ka ninka da ita ma tana canzawa bisa katunan. Kada ka kalli lambar mai lambobi biyu kaɗai.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.b: Har yanzu ba mu sani ba. Dole ne mu kwatanta da samfurorin wasu jeri na katunan.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ya lura cewa dole ne a gwada maganar ta hanyar kwatanta da sauran furuci. Hukunci ne mai kyau na ƙoƙarin tattara hujja.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.c: Ba ya kama da daidai. Mai ninkawa 3 ƙanƙanta ne, wataƙila hasara ce.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ya nuna mai ninkawa yana raguwa. Amma hasashe ne, don haka dole ne a bincika ta kwatanta da sauran furuci.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.o.d: Samfurin kusan ɗaya ne yadda ka jera su, don haka babu buƙatar kwatantawa.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.r.d: Kafin yanke cewa samfurorin kusan ɗaya ne, lissafa furuci kaɗan da kanka. Wataƙila sun bambanta sosai.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.explain: 75×3=225. Idan ka lissafa sauran furuci, akwai samfurin da ya fi girma, misali 35×7=245. Maganar Harin ba daidai ba ce, amma gwada wasu furuci da farko hanya ce mai kyau ta bincike.
y-m-07-06.s.s1.acc.0: Wannan hasashe ne mai ma'ana. Amma hasashe ne, dole ne ka nemo samfurorin da kanka ka bincika.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri furuci 2 daban masu samfurin da ya fi 240. Katin goma-goma t ne, na ɗaya u, katin ninkawa kuma m. Dole ne ka yi amfani da katunan 3, 5, da 7 sau ɗaya kowanne.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.0: Sanya kati ɗaya kowanne a matsayin goma-goma, ɗaya, da mai ninkawa, sannan ka lissafa samfurin.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ɗauki samfurin 75×3 a matsayin ma'auni, ka kwatanta yadda samfurin ke canzawa idan ka canza wurin da ka sa 7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan wurare ukun ɗaya ne daga 3, 5, ko 7.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Katunan 3, 5, da 7 kawai za ka iya amfani da su.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Ka yi amfani da kowane kati sau ɗaya daidai.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Kada ka yi amfani da kati ɗaya sau biyu. Dole ne ka yi amfani da 3, 5, da 7 sau ɗaya kowanne.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Samfurin bai fi 240 girma ba. Gwada canza wuraren katunan.
y-m-07-06.s.s2.explain: Akwai furuci 6 gabaɗaya da za a iya yi da katunan 3. Daga cikinsu furuci 3 sun fi 240, kuma 35×7=245 misali ne guda. 75×3 na Harin 225 ne, bai kai 240 ba.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.prompt: Daga furuci 6 da za a iya ƙirƙira da katunan 3, 5, da 7, wanne ne yake da samfurin mafi girma? Ka kuma rubuta dalilin da ya sa hanyar Harin (75×3) ba ta ba da samfurin mafi girma ba.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.0: Lissafa samfurorin furuci 6 duka, rubuta su a tebur, ka yi da'ira ga mafi girma.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta katin mai ninkawa a furucin da ke da samfurin mafi girma da na furucin Harin.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Furucin da samfurinsa ya fi girma shi ne ... Hanyar Harin ... saboda ...
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka yanke mafi girman samfurin bayan lissafa dukkan 6?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka kwatanta inda aka sa 7 a furucin Harin da furucin mafi girma?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa hanyar ‘kaɗai ka yi lambar lambobi biyu babba’ ba ta isa ba?
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.0: Samfurin mafi girma shi ne 53×7=371. Idan ka yi 75 kamar Harin, mai ninkawa 3 ne, don haka 75×3=225 ya fi ƙanƙanta. Amfani da babban lamba 7 a matsayin mai ninkawa ya ba da mafi girma.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.1: Amfani da 7 a matsayin mai ninkawa da ƙirƙirar 53 da sauran lambobin yana ba da 53×7=371, mafi girma. 75×3=225, saboda haka hanyar Harin ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Za ka iya kwatanta da 73×5=365 ma.
y-m-07-06.s.s3.model.2: Furucin da samfurin mafi girma shi ne 53×7. A 75×3, mai ninkawa ƙaramin 3 ne, don haka bai zama mafi girma ba.

y-m-07-05.title: Rabon 1/2 da 1/4 na zare: wane ne ya yi amfani da mafi yawa?
y-m-07-05.topic: Ana iya kwatanta girman kaso ne kawai idan dukan abu ɗaya ne (kaso daga dukan abubuwa daban-daban)
y-m-07-05.goal: Fahimci cewa ba za a iya kwatanta kaso daga dukan abubuwa daban-daban bisa girman kaso kaɗai ba; rarrabe bayanin da zai sa kwatantawa ta yiwu, sannan ka gano da lambobi yanayin da tsawon da mutanen biyu suka yi amfani da shi yake daidai.
y-m-07-05.material: Jian ta yi amfani da 1/2 na zare ja, Doyun kuma ya yi amfani da 1/4 na zare shuɗi. Ba mu sani ba ko zaren biyu tun farko tsawonsu ɗaya ne. Kowanne zare dunƙule guda ne wanda ba a yanke ba, kuma 1/2 da 1/4 suna nufin an raba dukkan zaren kowane mutum zuwa sassa daidai. Ana karanta 1/2 ‘rabin ɗaya’, 1/4 kuma ‘kwata ɗaya’.
y-m-07-05.thinking.1: Nemo sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata domin kwatantawa
y-m-07-05.prereq.0: Cewa kaso yana nuna adadin sassan daidai na duka da aka ɗauka
y-m-07-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi abin da za ka iya faɗa game da wanda ya yi amfani da zare mafi tsawo, bisa abin da ka sani yanzu kawai.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.hint.0: Yanke tsawon zaren ja da shuɗi yadda kake so (misali 20cm, 40cm), ka rubuta tsawon da mutanen biyu suka yi amfani da shi a cm.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.hint.1: Canza tsawon zaren ka duba ko wanda ya fi amfani yana canzawa.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.a: Ba mu san tsawon zaren biyu tun farko ba, don haka ba za mu iya yanke hukunci ba.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ya nuna cewa kaso yana nufin ‘dukan nasa’. Ka yi tunanin ƙarin bayanin da zai ba ka damar yanke hukunci.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.b: Jian ce, domin 1/2 ya fi 1/4 girma.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.b: 1/2 ya fi 1/4 ne kawai idan an kwatanta su daga duka abu ɗaya. Da farko duba ko dukan zaren biyu iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.c: Doyun ne, domin ma'aunin ƙasa 4 ya fi 2 girma.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.c: Ma'aunin ƙasa mafi girma ba ya sa tsawon da aka yi amfani da shi ya fi tsawo. Idan dukan zaren sun bambanta, tsawon cm yana canzawa.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.o.d: Wataƙila Jian ce. Yana da wuya dukan zaren su bambanta.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.r.d: Babu dalilin cewa ‘yana da wuya’. Gwada da lambobi abin da zai faru idan dukan zaren sun bambanta.
y-m-07-05.s.s1.explain: 1/2 ya fi 1/4 idan an kwatanta daga duka iri ɗaya (zare tsawonsu ɗaya). Misali, idan zaren ja 20cm ne, 1/2 = 10cm; amma idan shuɗi 80cm ne, 1/4 = 20cm, ya fi tsawo; idan shuɗi 8cm ne kuwa, 1/4 = 2cm, ya fi gajarta. Dole ne ka san tsawon zaren biyu domin yanke hukunci.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanin da idan ka san abu guda na ƙari kawai zai ba ka damar yanke hukuncin wanda ya fi amfani. (Yi tunani kan kowane zaɓi daban.)
y-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka ɗauka bayanin gaskiya ne, saita zaren ja a 20cm, ƙirƙiri misalai na tsawon zaren shuɗi ɗaya bayan ɗaya, ka nemo tsawon da mutanen biyu suka yi amfani da shi.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowane bayani, ƙirƙiri misalai biyu ko fiye na tsawon zaren shuɗi daban, ka duba ko hukuncin koyaushe iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.a: Zaren shuɗi ya fi zaren ja tsawo.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.a: ‘Ya fi tsawo’ kaɗai ba ya faɗin nawa ya fi tsawo. Gwada yanayin da zaren shuɗi ya kusan ninki 2 na ja.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.b: Zaren biyu tsawonsu ɗaya ne tun farko.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.b: Ka san cewa idan dukan abu ɗaya ne, za ka iya kwatanta girman kaso kai tsaye.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.c: Mutanen biyu sun yi amfani da rabin zaren nasu ko ƙasa da haka.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.c: 1/2 da 1/4 tuni rabin ko ƙasa da haka ne. Ba ka koyi wani sabon abu ba.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.d: Zaren shuɗi ya fi zaren ja gajarta.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.d: Idan shuɗi ya fi gajarta, 1/4 nasa ya fi gajarta ma, za ka iya kwatanta shi da 1/2 na ja. Wannan ya yi amfani da alaƙar girman dukan zaren.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.o.e: Zaren shuɗi tsawonsa ninki 4 na zaren ja ne.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.r.e: Wannan bayani ne da ke ba da alaƙar girman dukan abubuwan a matsayin ninki takamaimai. Za ka iya bayyana 1/4 bisa zaren ja.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.explain: A kira zaren ja R, shuɗi kuma B. Jian ta yi amfani da rabin R, Doyun kuma 1/4 na B. Idan zaren biyu iri ɗaya ne, Jian ta fi amfani. Idan shuɗi ya fi gajarta, Jian har yanzu ta fi amfani. Idan shuɗi ninki 4 ne, Doyun yana amfani da daidai da R, saboda haka Doyun ya fi yawa. Idan ka san shuɗi ya fi tsawo kawai, ba za ka san ko ninki 2 ya wuce ba, don haka ba za ka iya yanke hukunci ba.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.acc.0: Ka zaɓi bayanin da ya dace. Gwada ko sanin cewa tsawonsa ninki 4 ne ma zai ba ka damar yanke hukunci.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.acc.1: Ka zaɓi bayanin da ya dace. Gwada ko bayanin ‘ya fi gajarta’ ma zai ba ka damar yanke hukunci.
y-m-07-05.s.s2.acc.2: Ka zaɓi bayanin da ya dace. Gwada ko sanin cewa tsawon farko iri ɗaya ne ma zai ba ka damar yanke hukunci.
y-m-07-05.s.s3.prompt: Ka ce zaren ja 20cm ne. Shuɗi tsawon cm nawa zai zama domin mutanen biyu su yi amfani da tsawo iri ɗaya? Ka kuma rubuta wanda ya fi amfani idan shuɗi ya fi wannan tsawo. (Ana iya raba zaren zuwa sassa daidai.)
y-m-07-05.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta rabin zaren ja 20cm nawa ne a cm.
y-m-07-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin dukkan zaren shuɗi dole ya zama tsawon cm nawa domin ɗaya daga cikin sassa 4 masu daidai ya zama wannan tsawo.
y-m-07-05.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan zaren shuɗi ...cm ne, tsawonsu ɗaya ne. Dalili kuwa ...
y-m-07-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka fara nemo rabin (1/2) na zaren ja 20cm nawa ne a cm, sannan ka kwatanta da kashi ɗaya na shuɗi da aka raba gida 4?
y-m-07-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta daban ga yanayin shuɗi ya fi 40cm da kuma ya gaza 40cm?
y-m-07-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka san cewa hukuncin da ka rubuta yana cikin sharadin ‘idan zaren ja 20cm ne’?
y-m-07-05.s.s3.model.0: Sun yi daidai idan zaren shuɗi 40cm ne. Rabin 20cm (1/2) shi ne 10cm, 1/4 na 40cm ma 10cm ne. Idan ya fi 40cm tsawo, 1/4 ya fi 10cm tsawo, don haka Doyun ya fi amfani.
y-m-07-05.s.s3.model.1: 40cm ne. Rabin zaren ja 10cm ne, kuma kashi guda cikin sassa 4 daidai na shuɗi dole ya zama 10cm. Idan zaren shuɗi ya fi tsawo, kashi guda ya fi 10cm tsawo, saboda haka Doyun ya fi amfani.
y-m-07-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Na bayyana ta hanyar raba shi zuwa sassa.

y-m-07-02.title: Jakar marmara 6, marmara 47 a kowace, hanyoyin lissafi uku
y-m-07-02.topic: Hanyoyi da dama na lissafa (lamba mai lambobi biyu)×(lamba mai lamba ɗaya) ta hanyar rarraba lamba
y-m-07-02.goal: Nemo ka gyara layin da ba daidai ba cikin hanyoyin lissafin rarraba lamba, sannan ka tabbatar da misalinka cewa rarrabawa ta hanyoyi daban-daban tana ba da jimilla iri ɗaya, ka kuma bayyana dalili.
y-m-07-02.material: Akwai marmara 47 a kowace jaka, jakunkuna kuma 6 ne gaba ɗaya. Abokai uku sun nemo jimillar marmara ta sauya 47 zuwa wata lamba mai sauƙin lissafi. Yadda ake karantawa: 47×6 ana karantawa 'arba'in da bakwai ninki shida'.
y-m-07-02.thinking.0: Kwatanta mafita uku ka nemo kuskure
y-m-07-02.thinking.1: Samar da hanyoyi daban-daban na rarraba cikin sharuɗɗa
y-m-07-02.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa sakamako yake iri ɗaya ko da hanyoyi sun bambanta
y-m-07-02.prereq.1: Ninka gomomi da lamba mai lamba ɗaya (misali: 40×6)
y-m-07-02.prereq.2: An riga an yi (lamba mai lambobi biyu)×(lamba mai lamba ɗaya) a rubutacciyar hanya ta tsaye
y-m-07-02.s.s1.prompt: Waɗannan lissafen abokai ukun ne. Zaɓi layi ɗaya da lissafinsa ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko ka kwatanta ɗaya bayan ɗaya yadda abokan ukun suka sake rubuta 47.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta lambobin da abokan ukun suka yi amfani da su da 47, sannan ka duba layi bayan layi ko sun ƙara ko sun cire.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.line.2: Doha: Ya ɗauki 47 a matsayin 3 ƙasa da 50. 50×6=300, 3×6=18.
y-m-07-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ba daidai ba ne. Doha ta ɗauki 47 a matsayin '3 ƙasa da 50', saboda haka daga 50×6=300 dole ta cire 3×6=18, wato 300−18=282. Ƙara yana kama da ta yi lissafi da 53 maimakon 47. Lissafin Jian da na Seoa duk sun ba da 282 iri ɗaya.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.prompt: Kana son lissafa 47×6 ta raba 47 zuwa lambobi biyu a da b. Yi rarrabawa 3 mabambanta masu sauƙin lissafi. Sharuɗɗa: a da b cikakkun lambobi ne kuma a+b=47. Ɗaya daga cikinsu dole ya kasance lamba a jadawalin ninkin 5 (ninkin 5). Raba zuwa 40 da 7 da raba zuwa 7 da 40 suna ƙidayuwa a matsayin rarrabawa ɗaya.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka tabbatar ko a da b idan an haɗa su sun zama 47.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi lamba daga jadawalin ninkin 5, cire ta daga 47, ka nemo ɗayan lambar.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a da b dole su zama cikakkun lambobi masu aƙalla 1.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.ok.c2: a da b idan an haɗa su sun zama 47.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar a da b ba 47 ba ce.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Ɗaya daga cikinsu lamba ce a jadawalin ninkin 5.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Aƙalla ɗaya daga a da b dole ya zama ninkin 5 (5, 10, 15, ...).
y-m-07-02.s.s2.explain: Misali, 40+7, 45+2, 35+12, da 30+17 duk sun zama 47, kuma ɗaya daga cikin lambobin ninkin 5 ne. Ko yaya ka raba ta, haɗa (sashen lamba)×6 zai ba da 47×6=282.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Da ka lissafa kowane rarrabawar da ka yi, marmara nawa ka samu? A jimloli ɗaya ko biyu, rubuta dalilin da ya sa sakamako yake iri ɗaya ko da hanyar rarrabawa ta bambanta.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Ka rubuta sakamakon kowane rarrabawa da ka yi wuri guda ka kwatanta su.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko jimillar marmara za ta iya canzawa bisa tsarin ƙirga jakunkuna 6 na marmara 47.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Akwai marmara ... Ko da na canza yadda na raba, ... domin ...
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka tabbatar sakamakon 282 iri ɗaya ne ga duk rarrabawar da ka yi?
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta da kalmominka cewa 'raba 47, lissafawa, sannan sake haɗawa' ba ya canza jimillar marmara?
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka haɗa sharadin cewa lambobin da aka raba sun zama 47 da dalilin sakamako iri ɗaya?
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Jimillar marmara 282 ce. Ko yaya ka raba 47, kana sake haɗa ƙirgar jakunkuna 6 masu marmara 47 da ka yi a sassa, don haka jimillar ba ta canzawa.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Na samu marmara 282. Ko ka haɗa 40×6 da 7×6 ko 45×6 da 2×6, jimillar marmara iri ɗaya ce, saboda haka sakamakon iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Na yi bayani ta hanyar bayar da misalai biyu na kaina masu hanyoyin rarraba daban.
y-m-07-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Ko da hanyoyin rarrabawa sun bambanta, ƙimar 47×6 lamba ɗaya ce kawai, saboda haka dukkansu suna ba da 282.

y-m-07-04.prereq.1: Kimantawa ta hanyar zagayawa zuwa ɗarurruwa mafi kusa
y-m-07-04.title: Bayan an aro littattafai 285 cikin 603, sakamakon lissafi mai ban mamaki
y-m-07-04.topic: Yanayin da lissafa lamba ɗaya bayan ɗaya a rabo a rubutacciyar hanya ga lambobi masu lambobi uku yake daidai da marar daidai
y-m-07-04.goal: Nemo layin da bai daidai ba a mafitar rabo a rubuce, zaɓi hanyoyin binciken sakamako mai ban mamaki, ka nemo da misalai sharuɗɗan da wannan hanyar kuskure take zama daidai.
y-m-07-04.material: Laburare tana da littattafai 603, an aro 285 daga cikinsu. Eunu ya lissafa a rubutacciyar hanya yawan littattafan da suka rage, ya ce 'littattafai 482'. Ana karanta 603−285 'ɗari shida da uku a cire ɗari biyu da tamanin da biyar'. An nuna matakan lissafin Eunu a matsayin layuka a ɓangare na gaba.
y-m-07-04.thinking.0: Nemo wurin kuskure a matakan mafita
y-m-07-04.thinking.2: Nemo sharuɗɗan da hanyar kuskure take daidai
y-m-07-04.prereq.0: An riga an yi rabo a rubutacciyar hanya ga lambobi masu lambobi uku (sanin aro)
y-m-07-04.prereq.2: An riga an bincika sakamakon lissafi da wani lissafi
y-m-07-04.s.s1.prompt: Waɗannan matakan lissafin Eunu ne. Zaɓi layi ɗaya da bai daidai ba.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.hint.0: A rubutacciyar hanya, bi abin da Eunu ya yi layi bayan layi, farawa daga wurin raka'a.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka duba abin da Eunu ya yi lokacin da lambar sama ta yi ƙasa da ta ƙasa, ka yi tunanin ko ya yi daidai da 'cire 285 daga 603'.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.line.0: Rubuta 603−285 a rubutacciyar hanya ka lissafa daga wurin raka'a.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.line.1: Wurin raka'a: Ba za a iya cire 5 daga 3 ba, saboda haka rubuta 5−3=2.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.line.2: Wurin goma: Ba za a iya cire 8 daga 0 ba, saboda haka rubuta 8−0=8.
y-m-07-04.s.s1.explain: Layuka 2 da 3 ba daidai ba ne. Lokacin da lambar sama ta yi ƙasa da ta ƙasa kuma ba za a iya cirewa ba, Eunu ya musanya lambobin biyu sannan ya cire. A wannan yanayin dole ne a ara 10 daga wurin da ke sama a cire (aro). Idan aka yi haka, 603−285=318.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk hanyoyin gano cewa amsar Eunu 482 ba ta da ma'ana.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ga kowace hanyar bincike, ka yi tunani: 'shin kuskuren zai bayyana ko da na yi kuskure iri ɗaya da Eunu?'
y-m-07-04.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da kowace hanyar bincike ga amsar Eunwoo 482 ka rubuta a jere ko kuskuren ya bayyana.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.a: Sake lissafa daga farko da hanyar da Eunu ya yi.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.a: Idan ka yi amfani da hanya ɗaya, kuskure ɗaya zai maimaitu kuma adadi iri ɗaya zai fito. Kana buƙatar wata hanya dabam.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.b: Ƙara 482 da 285 ka duba ko ka samu 603.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.b: Wannan tunani ya duba sakamakon rabo ta koma baya da ƙari. Hanya ce dabam da ta Eunu, saboda haka tana iya gano kuskuren.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.c: Ka duba ko littattafai 482 da suka rage sun fi littattafai 603 na farko kaɗan.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.c: 482 ya yi ƙasa da 603. Amsa marar daidai ma tana iya cika wannan sharadi, saboda haka wannan kaɗai ba zai tona kuskure ba.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.o.d: Yi ƙiyasin 603 da 285 ka duba kusan littattafai nawa za su rage.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.r.d: Wannan hanya ce ta ƙiyastawa da kwatantawa da 482. Za ka iya gano amsar da ta yi nisa sosai ba tare da cikakken lissafi ba.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.explain: 482+285=767, ba 603 ba, don haka ba daidai ba ne. Haka kuma, 603 kusan 600 ne, 285 kuma kusan 300, saboda haka kusan littattafai 300 za su rage, amma 482 ya fi haka nisa. Sake lissafi da hanya ɗaya ko duba kawai ko 482 ya yi ƙasa da 603 ba zai gano kuskuren ba.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.acc.0: Binciken ta hanyar haɗawa daidai ne. Duba ko za ka iya bincika ta hanyar kimantawa ma.
y-m-07-04.s.s2.acc.1: Ka gano ta hanyar kimantawa cewa bambancin ya yi yawa. Duba ko akwai hanyar bincike daidai ta haɗawa ma.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.prompt: Akwai ragi kuma inda hanyar Eunu (cire ƙaramin lamba daga mafi girma a kowane matsayi sannan a rubuta) ta dace bisa sa'a. Ƙirƙiri ragi 2 daban inda ƙimar hanyar Eunu ta yi daidai da amsa daidai. Cire lamba mai lambobi uku b daga lamba mai lambobi uku a (a dole ta fi b girma). Hanyar Eunu ita ce rubuta bambancin lambobin biyu (mafi girma a cire mafi ƙanƙanta) a kowane matsayi na ɗaruruwa, goma-goma, da ɗaya.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo ƙimar hanyar Eunu da ƙimar hanyar da aka saba, ka kwatanta ko sun yi daidai.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta a tebur wanne daga lambobin sama da ƙasa ya fi girma a kowane matsayi, ka nemo inda misalai marasa kyau da masu kyau suka rabu.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.var.b: Lambar da za a cire b (mai lambobi uku)
y-m-07-04.s.s3.ok.c1: a lamba mai lambobi uku ce, kuma ta fi b girma.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.fail.c1: a da b lambobi ne na halitta masu lambobi uku, kuma a dole ya fi b girma.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.ok.c2: Ƙimar hanyar Eunu ta yi daidai da amsa daidai.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.fail.c2: Ƙimar hanyar Eunu ta bambanta da amsa daidai. Kwatanta lambobin a kowane matsayi.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.explain: Misali, 587−243 yana ba da 7−3=4, 8−4=4, 5−2=3; saboda haka hanyar Eunu tana ba da 344, kuma amsa daidai ita ma 344 ce. A irin waɗannan yanayi inda lambar sama a kowane matsayi ta fi ko ta yi daidai da ta ƙasa, ba a buƙatar aron lamba, saboda haka hanyar Eunu ma daidai ce.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Idan ka duba misalan da hanyar Eunu ta dace, irin wane ragi ne su? Kwatanta lambobin a kowane matsayi ka rubuta jimla ɗaya ko biyu.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Jera misalan da ka ƙirƙira, ka rubuta a tebur wanne ya fi girma a kowane matsayi, lambar sama ko ta ƙasa.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: A cikin 603−285, inda hanyar Eunu ba daidai ba ce, nemo ka kwatanta matsayin da lambar sama ta fi ƙasa ƙanƙanta.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.placeholder: Misali: A kowane matsayi, lambar sama ... ce
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: A misalan da ka ƙirƙira, ka duba cewa babu matsayi inda lambar sama ta fi ta ƙasa ƙanƙanta?
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana da kalmominka ma'anar ‘ba a buƙatar aro’?
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya haɗa matsayin da ya karya wannan sharadi a misalin da ba daidai ba (603−285)?
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.0: Ragi ne ba tare da aro ba. A 587−243, kamar 7−3, 8−4, da 5−2, lambar sama ta fi ta ƙasa girma a kowane matsayi, don haka yin kamar Eunu daidai ne.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.1: Ya dace ne idan lambar sama ta fi ko ta yi daidai da lambar ƙasa a kowane matsayi. Ragi ne da ba a buƙatar aro.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Na bayyana sharadin cewa ba a buƙatar aro da kalmomi na kaina.
y-m-07-04.s.s3.because.model.2: Yana aiki idan lambar sama ta fi girma a kowane matsayi. A 603−285 bai daidai ba domin a matsayin ɗaya 3 ta gaza 5.

y-m-07-03.title: Lissafi iri ɗaya, amma amsar tana canzawa bisa labari
y-m-07-03.topic: Yanayin da ake amfani da rabon (quotient) da ragowa na rabo mai ragowa ta hanyoyi daban-daban bisa labarai
y-m-07-03.goal: Fassara sakamakon rabo (quotient, ragowa) domin ya dace da tambayar labarin, sannan ka ƙirƙiri labaran da lissafi ɗaya yake ba da amsoshi mabambanta.
y-m-07-03.material: A rangadin kaka, ɗalibai 50 suna hawa kwale-kwale. Dukkan kwale-kwalen girma iri ɗaya suke kuma kowanne na ɗaukar mutane 8 aƙalla. Ba za a bar ɗalibi a baya ba. Idan aka lissafa 50÷8 (hamsin a raba da takwas), quotient ɗin 6 ne ragowar kuma 2. Za ka iya tabbatarwa da 8×6+2=50.
y-m-07-03.thinking.0: Fassara sakamakon lissafi domin ya dace da tambayar yanayi
y-m-07-03.thinking.1: Samar da yanayin da ya cika sharuɗɗa
y-m-07-03.thinking.2: Ƙirƙirar labarai da lissafi ɗaya yake ba da amsoshi mabambanta
y-m-07-03.prereq.0: Ma'anar quotient da ragowa a rabo (ragowa ta fi ƙasa da mai rabawa)
y-m-07-03.prereq.2: Rabo mai sauƙi da lambobi zuwa 100
y-m-07-03.s.s1.prompt: Domin ɗalibai 50 duka su hau, aƙalla kwale-kwale nawa ake buƙata?
y-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.0: Zana mutane 8 a cikin kwale-kwale a hoto ko jadawali ka ƙirga kwale-kwalen da suka cika.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo adadin mutanen da suka rage bayan kwale-kwale cikakku, ka yi tunanin inda mutanen za su hau.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauki quotient 6 kai tsaye a matsayin adadin kwale-kwale. Ka duba ko akwai ɗaliban da ba za su hau cikin kwale-kwale 6 cikakku ba.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ya ɗauki ƙarfin ɗaukar mutane 8 a matsayin adadin kwale-kwale. 8 shi ne yawan mutanen da kwale-kwale ɗaya zai ɗauka.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ya ɗauki ragowa 2 a matsayin adadin kwale-kwale. 2 shi ne yawan mutanen da suka rage.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ya haɗa sharadin cewa ɗaliban da suka rage suna buƙatar wurin hawa cikin sakamakon lissafi.
y-m-07-03.s.s1.explain: Kwale-kwale 6 na ɗaukar mutane 48, 2 kuma sun rage. Dole ne su ma su hau, saboda haka ana buƙatar wani kwale-kwale guda, jimilla kwale-kwale 7. A wannan labari, amsar ba quotient 6 ba ce, adadi ne da ya fi quotient da 1. (2)
y-m-07-03.s.s2.prompt: Idan adadin ɗalibai ya canza, yawan kwale-kwalen da ake buƙata ma zai canza. Yi yanayi 3 da ake buƙatar kwale-kwale 10 daidai, na ƙarshe kuma bai cika ƙarfinsa ba. Adadin ɗalibai n ne, ƙarfin kwale-kwale ɗaya c ne. Ƙarfin cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 2 zuwa 9, kuma dole ne duk ɗalibai su hau.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙarfin ɗauka, sannan ka canza adadin ɗalibai kusa da jimillar ƙarfin sau 9, ka ƙirga kwale-kwalen da ake buƙata.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.hint.1: Da zarar ka zaɓi adadin ɗalibai, nemo quotient da ragowar rabon, ka tabbatar ko akwai ɗalibai da suka rage.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Adadin ɗalibai da ƙarfin ɗauka cikakkun lambobi ne.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Adadin ɗalibai da ƙarfin ɗauka dole su zama cikakkun lambobi.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Ƙarfin ɗauka daga mutane 2 zuwa 9 ne.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ƙarfin ɗauka dole ya kasance daga mutane 2 zuwa 9.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Kwale-kwale na ƙarshe bai cika ƙarfinsa ba.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan adadin ɗalibai ya rabu da ƙarfin kwale-kwale babu ragowa, duk kwale-kwalen za su cika. Dole na ƙarshe ya kasance bai cika ba.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Ana buƙatar kwale-kwale 10 daidai domin duk ɗalibai su hau.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Ba kwale-kwale 10 ake buƙata ba. Raba adadin ɗalibai da ƙarfin ɗauka ka duba kwale-kwale cikakku da waɗanda suka rage.
y-m-07-03.s.s2.explain: Misali, da ɗalibai 75 da ƙarfin ɗauka 8, quotient na 75÷8 shi ne 9, ragowa 3. Ɗalibai 3 da suka rage bayan kwale-kwale 9 cikakku suna buƙatar wani guda, don haka kwale-kwale 10 ne. Ko da ƙarfin iri ɗaya ne, bisa yawan ɗalibai quotient na iya zama ɗaya, ragowa kaɗai kuma ta canza.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.prompt: Ta amfani da lissafi ɗaya 50÷8=6…2 (quotient 6, ragowa 2), ƙirƙiri labari ɗaya da amsarsa 6, wani kuma amsarsa 2. Tabbatar ka yi amfani da 50 da 8 a labaran.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin wasu labarai game da raba kaya cikin kwantena ko raba sayayya, kamar siyan kaya da 50원.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yanke shawarar ko tambayar ƙarshe a labarinka tana tambayar 'sau nawa/nawa za a iya cikawa' ko 'nawa ya rage'.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A labarin amsarsa 6, tambayar tana neman 'quotient' ne?
y-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: A labarin amsarsa 2, tambayar tana neman 'abin da ya rage' ne?
y-m-07-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Labarin biyun suna amfani da 50 da 8 yadda suke, kuma lissafinsu iri ɗaya ne da 50÷8?
y-m-07-03.s.s3.model.0: Amsa 6: Idan ka sayi alewa 8원 da 50원, za ka iya sayen guda 6. Amsa 2: Idan ka ɗaure littattafai 50 cikin dammuna 8, littattafai 2 za su rage.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.model.1: Amsa 6: Idan ka yanka igiya 50cm zuwa sassa 8cm, za ka samu sassa 6. Amsa 2: Idan ka raba alewa 50 daidai tsakanin mutane 8, kowane mutum ya samu 6, guda 2 kuma sun rage.
y-m-07-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Na bayyana cewa tambayar labari na biyu tana neman 'adadin da ya rage'.

y-m-07-01.title: Zan iya sayen kayan ciye-ciye da abin sha da 1000 won?
y-m-07-01.topic: Idan aka kimanta lambobi masu lambobi uku, me za ka iya koya idan kimantawar ta yi daidai da ma'aunin kwatanci?
y-m-07-01.goal: Fahimci cewa idan kimantawa ta yi daidai da ma'aunin kwatanci (1000 won), yana da wuya a yanke hukunci ta kimantawa kaɗai. Gyara hukuncinka da tabbacin da kake da shi duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya fito, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misali inda, ko da kimantawar ta yi daidai, ainihin ƙimomin za su iya kasancewa a gefuna biyu na ma'aunin kwatanci.
y-m-07-01.material: Hajun yana son sayen kayan ciye-ciye guda ɗaya da abin sha guda ɗaya a shago. A walat ɗinsa akwai takardar kuɗi 1000 won guda ɗaya kawai. Dukkan farashin lambobi ne na halitta a won. Idan ana kimanta zuwa ɗaruruwa mafi kusa, a zagaye sama idan lambar goma 5 ko fiye ce, ƙasa kuma idan 4 ko ƙasa ce. Misali, 460 ana kimanta shi a matsayin 500, 440 kuma a matsayin 400.
y-m-07-01.thinking.0: Bambance abin da za ka iya faɗa da wanda ba za ka iya faɗa ba daga ƙimar da aka kimanta
y-m-07-01.thinking.1: Gyara hukuncinka da tabbacin da kake da shi yayin da kake samun sabon bayani
y-m-07-01.thinking.2: Ƙirƙirar misalai mabambanta da suka cika sharuɗɗan
y-m-07-01.prereq.0: Kimanta lambobi masu lambobi uku zuwa ɗaruruwa mafi kusa (misali: 487 yana kusa da 500)
y-m-07-01.prereq.1: Kwatanta girman lambobi masu lambobi uku
y-m-07-01.prereq.2: Sanin yawan kuɗin 1000 won (500 won+500 won)
y-m-07-01.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi abin da Hajun zai iya faɗa. Za ka iya riƙe tunaninka na baya ko ka gyara shi.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunani ko kalmomin “kusan 500 won” suna nufin ainihin farashin zai iya fi ko ƙasa da 500 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta yawan da kowace sabuwar lamba da aka bayyana ta fi ko ƙasa da 500, sannan ka kwatanta waɗannan adadi da juna.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Hajun ya kalli alamun farashi daga nesa a gaban shiryayye. Ya karanta farashin kayan ciye-ciye da na abin sha duka a matsayin “kusan 500 won.” (Bai san ainihin lambobin ba tukuna.)
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: 1000 won ya isa in sayi kayan ciye-ciye guda ɗaya da abin sha guda ɗaya?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Abin da muka sani kawai shi ne farashin biyun suna kusa da 500 won. Kimantawar jimillar ta yi daidai da ma'aunin kwatanci 1000, saboda haka daga kimantawa kaɗai ba za mu iya sanin ko ainihin jimillar ta fi ko ta yi ƙasa da 1000 ba.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 500+500=1000, saboda haka tabbas zan iya sayensu da 1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kimantawa ta zama 1000 ba ya nufin ainihin jimillar 1000 ce. Kimantawa na iya zama kaɗan sama ko ƙasa da ainihin ƙimar.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kimantawar ita ce 1000, saboda haka ta wuce 1000 won kuma ba zan iya sayen su ba.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kimantawa 1000 ta yi daidai da kuɗin da nake da shi, 1000 won. Domin a ce “ta wuce,” dole ta fi 1000 girma.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kimantawar daidai 1000 won ce, saboda haka yana da wuya a yanke hukunci ta kimantawa kaɗai.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan tunani ya yi la'akari da cewa idan kimantawa ta yi daidai da ma'aunin kwatanci, ainihin ƙimar na iya fi ko ƙasa da ma'aunin.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ban san ainihin farashin ba, saboda haka ba zan iya cewa komai ba.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kimantawa ma bayani ne mai amfani. Ka san kowane farashi yana kusa da 500 won. Ka tantance iyakar abin da za ka iya sani daga wannan bayanin.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Da ya matso ya duba, kayan ciye-ciye 487 won ne, abin sha kuma 518 won ne.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu me kake tunani game da kwatanta jimillar farashin biyun da 1000 won?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.after: 487 ya yi ƙasa da 500 da 13, 518 kuma ya fi 500 da 18, saboda haka jimillar ta fi 1000 da 5. Idan aka haɗa daidai, 487+518=1005. Hukuncin farko cewa “yana da wuya a yanke” har yanzu daidai ne, yanzu kuma akwai dalili.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ragin 18 ya fi gibin 13, saboda haka jimillar ta fi 1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan ya gano cewa 518 ya fi 500 da 18, 487 kuma ya yi ƙasa da 500 da 13, sannan ya kwatanta abin da ya fi da abin da ya yi ƙasa. Hanya ce mai kyau ta sake duba ƙimomin da aka kimanta da lambobi.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 487 ya yi ƙasa da 500, saboda haka jimillar ma ta yi ƙasa da 1000 won.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan ya manta cewa 518 ya fi 500. Dole ne ka duba yadda kowane farashi ya bambanta da 500 tare.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Dukkansu kusan 500 ne, saboda haka jimillar daidai 1000 won ce.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: “Kusan” ba yana nufin daidai ba. Nemo bambancin lambar da ke kan kowane alamar farashi da 500.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Kimantawa kaɗai ba ta gaya mini ba, saboda haka zan haɗa 487+518 daidai domin yanke shawara.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana ganin kimantawa ba ta isa ba, yana ƙoƙarin dubawa ta hanyar lissafi daidai. Kyakkyawan hali ne a yi amfani da kimantawa da lissafi tare.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Hajun ya sami ƙarin kuɗaɗen 10 won guda 2 a cikin walat ɗinsa. Yanzu jimillar kuɗin da yake da ita 1020 won ce.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me zai iya faɗa idan ya haɗa sabon bayanin?
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1005원 ya yi ƙasa da 1020원, don haka zai iya saya kuma 15원 zai rage. Ko farashin iri ɗaya ne, idan kuɗin da yake da shi ya canza, ƙarshe ma yana canzawa. Yanke hukunci bisa ƙiyasin 1000 kawai ya yi daidai a wannan karon, amma dalilinsa bai da ƙarfi.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Jimillar 1005원 ce, ta fi 1000원, don haka har yanzu ba zai iya sayen su ba.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan bai haɗa sabbin kuɗaɗen da aka gano da kuɗin da yake da shi ba. Da farko ka duba ko kuɗin da yake da shi ya canza.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Jimillar 1005원 ta yi ƙasa da kuɗin da yake da shi, 1020원, don haka zai iya saya.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan ya kwatanta sabon kuɗin da yake da shi kai tsaye da ainihin jimilla. Ya yi la'akari da kyau cewa sabon bayani yana canza sharadi.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ƙiyasin 1000 ya yi ƙasa da 1020, saboda haka zai iya saya idan ya kalli ƙiyasin kawai.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ƙarshe ɗaya ne, amma ka tuna yadda ƙiyasin da ainihin jimilla suka bambanta. Yana da wuya a amince da kwatanta ƙiyase idan bambancin kaɗan ne.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: 1005 da 1020 suna kama da juna, saboda haka ba za mu iya sanin wanne ya fi girma ba.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ana iya kwatanta 1005 da 1020 nan take. Kwatanta girman lambobin ka ga wanne ya fi girma.
y-m-07-01.s.s1.reflect: Daga maganar cewa ƙiyasin farko 1000 ne, me za ka iya sani, me kuma ba za ka iya sani ba? Bayan ganin ainihin lambobin kan alamun farashi, da kuma gano ƙarin kuɗaɗe, ta yaya tunaninka ko tabbacin ka suka canza? Idan ka riƙe tunaninka na farko, ka faɗi dalili ma.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.prompt: Yi nau'i-nau'i biyu na farashi waɗanda ƙiyasin jimillarsu 1000원 ne amma ainihin jimillarsu ba 1000원 ba ce. Ɗaya daga cikin nau'i-nau'in jimillarsa ta fi 1000원, ɗayan kuma ta yi ƙasa da 1000원. Abun ciye-ciye a원 da abin sha b원 kowannensu cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 100원 zuwa 999원.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yi nau'in da jimillarsa ta fi 1000. Farashi ɗaya ya ɗan haura 500, ɗayan kuma ya ɗan yi ƙasa da 500.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.hint.1: Da zarar ka yi nau'i ɗaya, musanya adadin da ya haura da wanda ya yi ƙasa domin yin nau'in da jimillarsa ta yi ƙasa da 1000.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Farashin biyun cikakkun lambobi ne daga 100원 zuwa 999원.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Farashin biyun dole ne su zama cikakkun lambobi daga 100 zuwa 999.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Idan aka ƙiyasta kowanne zuwa ɗari mafi kusa sannan aka haɗa, jimillar 1000 ce.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan aka ƙiyasta farashin kowanne zuwa ɗari mafi kusa sannan aka haɗa, jimillar ba 1000 ba ce. Duba ƙa'idar ɗaga sama idan lambar goma ta 5 ko fiye ce.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan ainihin jimillar ta zama 1000원 daidai, iri ɗaya ce da ƙiyasin, don haka ba misali ba ne.
y-m-07-01.s.s2.explain: 487+518=1005 ya fi 1000, 480+510=990 kuma ya yi ƙasa da 1000. Ko da ƙiyase iri ɗaya ne, 1000, ainihin jimilla na iya kasancewa a kowane gefe na ƙimar ma'auni. Saboda haka idan ƙiyasin ya yi daidai da ma'aunin, kada a yanke hukunci daga ƙiyasin kawai; a ƙara dubawa sosai.
